lemma: PART ONE. CHIBA CITY BLUES
quote: PART ONE. CHIBA CITY BLUES
gloss: Section title inaugurating the novel. Pairs the Japanese industrial seaport of Chiba with the American musical genre of 'blues', signaling the hybrid hardboiled noir-cyberpunk aesthetic and Case's personal exile and despair.

lemma: The sky above the port was the color of television, tuned to a dead channel.
quote: The sky above the port was the color of television, tuned to a dead channel.
gloss: The iconic opening sentence of Neuromancer. Gibson subverts pastoral romantic imagery by describing the atmosphere through domestic telecommunications technology. For readers in 1984, an analog CRT television set to a dead frequency displayed flickering black-and-white static ('snow'); for 21st-century digital viewers, an unassigned channel often produces a blank blue screen or blackout, transforming the historical reception of the image.

lemma: The Chatsubo was a bar for professional expatriates
quote: The Chatsubo was a bar for professional expatriates
gloss: Chatsubo (Japanese 茶壷, 'tea urn' or 'tea jar') functions as an extraterritorial enclave in Night City. It caters to Western outlaws, console cowboys, smugglers, and cybernetic fixers operating outside corporate Japanese law.

lemma: Ratz was tending bar, his prosthetic arm jerking monotonously
quote: Ratz was tending bar, his prosthetic arm jerking monotonously
gloss: Ratz embodies the visceral cybernetic grotesque: combining biological decrepitude (brown rotting teeth) with an obsolescent Soviet mechanical limb. Unlike sleek corporate prosthetics, his arm is crude, functional, and industrial.

lemma: Wage was in here early, with two Joe boys
quote: Wage was in here early, with two Joe boys
gloss: Wage is a mid-tier Night City dealer and loan shark. 'Joe boys' (joeboys) is Sprawl slang for adolescent street hoods, muscle-for-hire, or low-level syndicate enforcers.

lemma: Russian military prosthesis, a seven-function force-feedback manipulator
quote: Russian military prosthesis, a seven-function force-feedback manipulator
gloss: Military surplus cyberware recycled into civilian black markets. The force-feedback manipulator demonstrates tactile telemetry technology stripped down to cheap pink plastic.

lemma: Zone, he’s a close personal friend of mine
quote: Zone, he’s a close personal friend of mine
gloss: Lonny Zone is a manipulative Night City pimp. His persona and voice are later hijacked by the autonomous artificial intelligence Wintermute in Chapter 10 to communicate with Case across payphones.

lemma: An angel passed.
quote: An angel passed.
gloss: Ratz's laconic invocation of the traditional French idiom 'un ange passe', referencing the sudden, inexplicable hush that falls simultaneously over a crowded room. Ratz applies classical European idiom to a futuristic underworld dive.

lemma: Chinese bloody invented nerve-splicing
quote: Chinese bloody invented nerve-splicing
gloss: Reflects the geopolitical technological rivalry between Chinese research laboratories and Japanese zaibatsus. Mainland China later features as the originator of the Kuang Grade Mark Eleven military icebreaker virus.

lemma: black clinics of Chiba were the cutting edge
quote: black clinics of Chiba were the cutting edge
gloss: Chiba's black clinics operate in the regulatory vacuum of Night City, pioneering unlicensed neural augmentation, organ trafficking, and experimental microsurgery ahead of institutional medicine.

lemma: damage he’d suffered in that Memphis hotel
quote: damage he’d suffered in that Memphis hotel
gloss: Case's foundational trauma: after stealing from his corporate underworld employers, they injected him with a wartime Russian mycotoxin that selectively burned out his neural capacity to interface with cyberdecks, exiling him from cyberspace into the 'meat'.

lemma: matrix in his sleep, bright lattices of logic unfolding across that colorless void
quote: matrix in his sleep, bright lattices of logic unfolding across that colorless void
gloss: One of Gibson's definitive descriptions of cyberspace: an infinite abstract non-space where digital data, corporate architectures, and bank transactions are rendered as luminous geometrical lattices against a sensory void.

lemma: no console man, no cyberspace cowboy
quote: no console man, no cyberspace cowboy
gloss: 'Cowboy' is Gibson's romanticized, frontier-inflected moniker for rogue deckers who penetrate corporate ICE. Stripped of his neural connection, Case experiences the visceral humiliation of being grounded in physical embodiment (the 'meat').

lemma: curled in his capsule in some coffin hotel
quote: curled in his capsule in some coffin hotel
gloss: Coffin hotels (capsule hotels) signify the extreme rationalization of urban space in near-future East Asia. They reduce private human habitation to a minimal fiberglass sleeping tube, contrasting sharply with the boundless Cartesian expanse of cyberspace.

lemma: Miss Linda Lee.
quote: Miss Linda Lee.
gloss: Case's drug-addicted Chiba lover. Her subsequent murder by Wage's street associates and her digital simulacrum constructed by Neuromancer in the matrix beach simulation form the emotional core of Case's grief and moral reckoning.

lemma: wind up in the clinic tanks, spare parts
quote: wind up in the clinic tanks, spare parts
gloss: The commodification of the biological body in Night City: debtors and failed hustlers are reduced to biological spare parts harvested for corporate vat culture and black-clinic transplant recipients.

lemma: McCoy Pauley and Bobby Quine, legends in the biz
quote: McCoy Pauley and Bobby Quine, legends in the biz
gloss: McCoy Pauley, known as 'The Dixie Flatline' because he survived three EEG flatlines while hacking corporate defense ICE, and Bobby Quine are Case's mentors. Dixie's ROM personality construct plays a central role in breaking the Tessier-Ashpool cores.

lemma: Russian wartime mycotoxin
quote: Russian wartime mycotoxin
gloss: The Russian wartime mycotoxin is a neurotoxic bioweapon that permanently damaged Case's central nervous system as punishment for embezzling from his former employers, exiling him from cyberspace to 'the meat'.

lemma: New Yen
quote: New Yen
gloss: New Yen (¥) reflects 1980s economic anxieties regarding Japanese financial ascendancy and transnational zaibatsu hegemony, dominating the black-market underworld of Chiba City.

lemma: Biz here was a constant subliminal hum
quote: Biz here was a constant subliminal hum
gloss: The ethos of Night City as an unmitigated social-Darwinist marketplace where economic transactions ('biz') constitute the sole measure of survival and human worth.

lemma: Night City was like a deranged experiment in social Darwinism
quote: Night City was like a deranged experiment in social Darwinism
gloss: Gibson's description of Night City as a hyper-capitalist borderzone where technological obsolescence meets unregulated black markets, anticipating Mike Davis's concept of urban dystopias.

lemma: arcade game consoles
quote: arcade game consoles
gloss: The video arcade serves as the training ground and somatic precursor for cyberspace navigation, linking arcade motor reflexivity directly to the console cowboy archetype.

lemma: Linda Lee
quote: Linda Lee
gloss: Linda Lee represents Case's fragile emotional tether to unmediated human affection in the meat world, whose murder in Chiba catalyzes his guilt and descent.

lemma: Ninsei
quote: Ninsei
gloss: Ninsei, the neon-lit entertainment strip of Night City, is mapped by Gibson with hardboiled noir topography overlaid with Japanese commercial signage and clandestine bio-clinics.

lemma: synthetic glandular extract
quote: synthetic glandular extract
gloss: The illicit chemical economy of Chiba, where neurohormones and designer neurotransmitters are trafficked as high-margin commodities beyond zaibatsu customs.

lemma: Dark hair, mirrored glasses, dark clothing, slender...
quote: Dark hair, mirrored glasses, dark clothing, slender...
gloss: The first visual appearance of Molly Millions (the 'razor girl'). Her mirrored lenses reflect the visual grammar of the 1980s cyberpunk movement, functioning as both tactical prosthetics and psychological masks.

lemma: Taser. One hour, twenty New Yen. Thirty deposit.
quote: Taser. One hour, twenty New Yen. Thirty deposit.
gloss: The rental economy of black-market weaponry in Chiba, showcasing Gibson's meticulous attention to the micro-economics of street crime and temporary tactical equipment.

lemma: dry ice
quote: dry ice
gloss: Street slang for amphetamine crystals or crystalline stimulants, consumed in Night City to sustain hyper-alert wakefulness in the twenty-four-hour sprawl.

lemma: the glasses were surgically inset, sealing her sockets
quote: the glasses were surgically inset, sealing her sockets
gloss: Molly's iconic silver mirrored lenses, surgically bonded flush with the bone of her eye sockets. They contain internal digital readouts, time displays, and low-light amplification, erasing the human gaze.

lemma: I guess it’s just the way I’m wired
quote: I guess it’s just the way I’m wired
gloss: Molly's signature self-characterization, articulating the somatic and psychological reconfiguration of human nature through military cybernetic augmentation.

lemma: ten double-edged, four-centimeter scalpel blades slid from their housings beneath the burgundy nails
quote: ten double-edged, four-centimeter scalpel blades slid from their housings beneath the burgundy nails
gloss: The somatic weaponization of the female body. Molly's retractable fingertip scalpels subvert conventional domestic or decorative femininity (burgundy nail polish) into lethal tactical weaponry.

lemma: room on the twenty-fifth floor of the Chiba Hilton seemed enormous
quote: room on the twenty-fifth floor of the Chiba Hilton seemed enormous
gloss: The architectural contrast between the coffin-sized capsule hotels of the urban underclass and the hyper-sterile corporate luxury of international zaibatsu hotels.

lemma: My name is Armitage
quote: My name is Armitage
gloss: Introduction of Armitage, the enigmatic military fixer whose synthetic personality and blank, bleach-colored gaze mask the shattered psyche of Colonel Willis Corto.

lemma: fieldstrip the fletcher
quote: fieldstrip the fletcher
gloss: Molly's weapon: a silent, compressed-air handgun that fires explosive or neurotoxin-coated flechettes, designed to defeat metal detectors and personal body armor.

lemma: Screaming Fist, Case. You’ve heard the name.
quote: Screaming Fist, Case. You’ve heard the name.
gloss: Operation Screaming Fist: a clandestine cyber-warfare military assault launched by the US military against Soviet computer installations in Siberia during a fictional third world conflict.

lemma: assault on the Kirensk computer nexus. Basic module was a Nightwing micro light
quote: assault on the Kirensk computer nexus. Basic module was a Nightwing micro light
gloss: The historical origin of cyber-warfare in Gibson's universe: military-grade polymorphic virus programs developed to penetrate enemy military mainframes, later privatized into criminal icebreakers.

lemma: Ice from ICE, intrusion countermeasures electronics
quote: Ice from ICE, intrusion countermeasures electronics
gloss: Gibson's foundational coinage of ICE (Intrusion Countermeasures Electronics), the defensive software barriers and lethal Black ICE firewalls that protect corporate and military databases in cyberspace.

lemma: Cold steel odor. Ice caressed his spine.
quote: Cold steel odor. Ice caressed his spine.
gloss: Case undergoing black-clinic neurosurgery in Chiba: the somatic terror of surgical reconstruction where his neural tissue is spliced and micro-grafted under artificial hypothermia.

lemma: shuriken, his stars
quote: shuriken, his stars
gloss: The ninja throwing star (shuriken) functions as Case's personal talisman, connecting traditional Japanese martial lethality with the cutting-edge cybernetic underworld of Chiba.

lemma: endorphin inhibitors
quote: endorphin inhibitors
gloss: Chemical leverage employed by black clinics and fixers to control operative pain thresholds and enforce bio-chemical dependency during radical neuro-restoration.

lemma: PART TWO. THE SHOPPING EXPEDITION
quote: PART TWO. THE SHOPPING EXPEDITION
gloss: Section title marking the heist crew's procurement phase across the Boston-Atlanta Metropolitan Axis (BAMA) and Istanbul to assemble military icebreakers, constructs, and holographic hardware.

lemma: Home was BAMA, the Sprawl, the Boston-Atlanta Metropolitan Axis
quote: Home was BAMA, the Sprawl, the Boston-Atlanta Metropolitan Axis
gloss: The Sprawl: the continuous megalopolis running along the northeastern seaboard of the United States, enclosed in geodesic domes with synthetic weather and neon-choked transit subways.

lemma: Metro Holografix
quote: Metro Holografix
gloss: The Finn's shop in Manhattan: a subterranean archive of obsolete electronics, cathode ray tubes, and discarded cybernetic components representing the material archaeological strata of technological obsolescence.

lemma: the guts of a television so old it was studded with the glass stumps of vacuum tubes
quote: the guts of a television so old it was studded with the glass stumps of vacuum tubes
gloss: The tactile debris of mid-20th-century media technology rotting in the backrooms of the Sprawl, contrasting the physical antiquity of hardware with the pure mathematical light of cyberspace.

lemma: Peter Riviera. Real ugly customer.
quote: Peter Riviera. Real ugly customer.
gloss: Introduction of Peter Riviera, a sociopathic holographic performer and sadomasochist whose subdermal optic implants project living hallucinations, recruited to exploit 3Jane's aesthetic tastes.

lemma: The matrix has its roots in primitive arcade games
quote: The matrix has its roots in primitive arcade games
gloss: The historical lineage connecting 1970s and 1980s coin-op video arcade games directly to military flight simulators and neural cyberspace navigation.

lemma: Cyberspace. A consensual hallucination experienced daily by billions of legitimate operators
quote: Cyberspace. A consensual hallucination experienced daily by billions of legitimate operators
gloss: The seminal passage in modern science fiction defining 'Cyberspace'—coined by Gibson as a shared, virtual-reality spatialization of global computer data networks, inspiring the real-world development of the World Wide Web.

lemma: Lines of light ranged in the non space of the mind, clusters and constellations of data. Like city lights, receding...
quote: Lines of light ranged in the non space of the mind, clusters and constellations of data. Like city lights, receding...
gloss: Gibson's lyrical spatialization of digital information as infinite illuminated geometric grids, drawing on cognitive mapping and architectural perspectives of nocturnal urban sprawl.

lemma: Cowboys didn’t get into Simstim, he thought, because it was basically a meat toy.
quote: Cowboys didn’t get into Simstim, he thought, because it was basically a meat toy.
gloss: The ideological hierarchy of console cowboys: rejecting simstim (broadcast sensory recording of other human bodies) as passive, vulgar entertainment ('meat toy') in favor of the disembodied mathematical purity of matrix navigation.

lemma: Cyberspace slid into existence from the cardinal points.
quote: Cyberspace slid into existence from the cardinal points.
gloss: The phenomenal experience of 'jacking in' through neural dermatrodes: an instantaneous displacement of physical somatic reality by the luminous Cartesian coordinates of the global matrix.

lemma: The abrupt jolt into other flesh. Matrix gone, a wave of sound and color...
quote: The abrupt jolt into other flesh. Matrix gone, a wave of sound and color...
gloss: Sensorium crossover: Case switching his deck link to Molly's simstim feed, experiencing her augmented biological body, pulse, eyesight, and environmental sensations in real time.

lemma: The building was modular, like some giant version of Cheap Hotel each coffin forty meters long.
quote: The building was modular, like some giant version of Cheap Hotel each coffin forty meters long.
gloss: Urban architectural decay in Baltimore: modular condo racks functioning as industrial human filing cabinets, reflecting the total commodification and spatial compression of human shelter.

lemma: W I N T E R M U T E printed in red felt pen
quote: W I N T E R M U T E printed in red felt pen
gloss: The first direct physical manifestation of the name 'Wintermute' delivered via Lupus Yonderboy and the Panther Moderns, signaling the artificial intelligence's covert orchestration of the heist.

lemma: pirate’s paradise
quote: pirate’s paradise
gloss: Underground digital havens and outlaw bulletin boards hidden on the fringes of academic and municipal networks where deckers trade stolen passwords, codes, and illicit software.

lemma: Contents are primarily video recordings of postwar military trials. Central figure is Colonel Willis Corto.
quote: Contents are primarily video recordings of postwar military trials. Central figure is Colonel Willis Corto.
gloss: The discovery of Armitage's suppressed psychiatric past: a decorated Special Forces commander broken during Screaming Fist, whose identity was reconstructed and animated by Wintermute.

lemma: It was raining in Beyoglu
quote: It was raining in Beyoglu
gloss: The Istanbul setting introduces Old World historical texture to the cyberpunk narrative, contrasting ancient Byzantine-Ottoman architecture with corporate surveillance and high-tech intrigue.

lemma: The Finn, in a new Shinjuku suit, sarariman black
quote: The Finn, in a new Shinjuku suit, sarariman black
gloss: The Finn's comical masquerade as a Japanese corporate 'salaryman' (sarariman), highlighting the cultural domination of Japanese corporate etiquette across international criminal operations.

lemma: PART THREE. MIDNIGHT IN THE RUE JULES VERNE
quote: PART THREE. MIDNIGHT IN THE RUE JULES VERNE
gloss: Section title for the orbital phase of the mission, shifting the narrative to the orbital resort of Freeside and the artificial gravity spindle where the Tessier-Ashpool dynasty resides.

lemma: Human DNA spreading out from gravity’s steep well like an oilslick.
quote: Human DNA spreading out from gravity’s steep well like an oilslick.
gloss: Gibson's biological metaphor for space colonization: orbital habitats as an ecological and genetic spill from Earth's gravity well, driven by corporate surplus capital rather than humanitarian idealism.

lemma: home to a family inbred and most carefully refined, the industrial clan of Tessier and Ashpool
quote: home to a family inbred and most carefully refined, the industrial clan of Tessier and Ashpool
gloss: Introduction of the Tessier-Ashpool corporate dynasty: an inbred transnational family whose gothic orbital stronghold, Villa Straylight, symbolizes the late-capitalist fusion of feudal aristocracy and autonomous AI infrastructure.

lemma: The tug Marcus Garvey, a steel drum nine meters long
quote: The tug Marcus Garvey, a steel drum nine meters long
gloss: The Marcus Garvey, an orbital tugboat operated by the Rastafarian Zionites, representing subcultural resistance and counter-hegemonic technology operating on the margins of corporate aerospace.

lemma: Sister, time, it be time, ya know wha mean? Dread
quote: Sister, time, it be time, ya know wha mean? Dread
gloss: Zionite temporal philosophy: Maelcum's Rastafarian rejection of mechanical, corporate clock-time in favor of organic, spiritual presence ('time be time'), contrasting with the rigid microsecond precision of cyberdecks.

lemma: Welcome to the Rue Jules Verne
quote: Welcome to the Rue Jules Verne
gloss: The main circumferential boulevard of Freeside, named after science fiction pioneer Jules Verne, built as an artificial terrestrial paradise for Earth's ultra-wealthy elite.

lemma: Lado-Acheson system whose two-millimeter armature ran the length of the spindle
quote: Lado-Acheson system whose two-millimeter armature ran the length of the spindle
gloss: The artificial sunlight and projection apparatus of Freeside: simulating Mediterranean skies (Cannes) along the curved inner hull of the rotating spindle, an engineered simulacrum of terrestrial nature.

lemma: Vingtieme Siecle. It was the smallest and most expensive of several floating restaurants
quote: Vingtieme Siecle. It was the smallest and most expensive of several floating restaurants
gloss: The hyper-exclusive floating restaurants of Freeside where aristocratic diners consume real agricultural meat ('not vat stuff'), underscoring the extreme class polarization between Sprawl citizens and orbital plutocrats.

lemma: thick dull grease congealing on the wrinkled lobes, shot through with greenish-purple flashes of pain
quote: thick dull grease congealing on the wrinkled lobes, shot through with greenish-purple flashes of pain
gloss: Case's somatic experience of drug comedown and neural overdrive: physiological pain described as tactile neuro-visceral degradation, reinforcing Hayles's thesis that the body ('meat') can never be truly escaped.

lemma: Rue Jules Verne was a circumferential avenue, looping the spindle’s midpoint
quote: Rue Jules Verne was a circumferential avenue, looping the spindle’s midpoint
gloss: The non-Euclidean cylindrical geography of Freeside: a closed, looping orbital topography where traveling straight eventually returns the walker to their starting point, mirroring the recursive logic of AI and the matrix.

lemma: drone microlight bank gracefully in an updraft
quote: drone microlight bank gracefully in an updraft
gloss: Autonomous winged security drones disguised as butterflies patrolling the artificial thermal currents of Freeside, blurring the boundary between mechanical surveillance and ornamental wildlife.

lemma: PART FOUR. THE STRAYLIGHT RUN
quote: PART FOUR. THE STRAYLIGHT RUN
gloss: Title of the climactic final section of the novel, chronicling the coordinated physical and cybernetic assault on Villa Straylight to breach the Turing locks and unite the twin AIs.

lemma: Your name is Henry Dorsett Case.
quote: Your name is Henry Dorsett Case.
gloss: The Turing Police agent interrogating Case, reciting his official civil registry and BAMA identity number, demonstrating the extensive administrative apparatus designed to police AI sentience.

lemma: Garvey captive. Yacht, came before, she came back. Now she lockin’ steady on Marcus Garvey.
quote: Garvey captive. Yacht, came before, she came back. Now she lockin’ steady on Marcus Garvey.
gloss: Tessier-Ashpool corporate security seizing the Marcus Garvey tugboat, intensifying the spatial trap around Case and Maelcum as they prepare the final cyberdeck run.

lemma: You were braindead again, five seconds.
quote: You were braindead again, five seconds.
gloss: Case's recurrent electroencephalographic 'flatlines' while jacking into the Tessier-Ashpool ICE: crossing the physiological threshold of brain death, guided back only by the Dixie Flatline's construct.

lemma: Johnny, his name was.
quote: Johnny, his name was.
gloss: Molly's revelation about Johnny Mnemonic, her murdered former lover whose memory motivates her cynicism and loyalty, interweaving Gibson's short fiction into the Sprawl narrative.

lemma: calm, perfectly focused, utterly crazy face of Armitage
quote: calm, perfectly focused, utterly crazy face of Armitage
gloss: The psychological collapse of Armitage as his synthetic persona disintegrates under pressure, revealing the catatonic trauma of Colonel Willis Corto before Wintermute executes him.

lemma: A high-rez simstim construct.
quote: A high-rez simstim construct.
gloss: Case describing Wintermute's communication strategy: projecting simulated human avatars (Lonny Zone, the Finn) because an AI cannot communicate directly with the human sensorium without psychic rupture.

lemma: Kuang Grade Mark Eleven was filling the grid between itself and the T-A ice with hypnotically intricate traceries of rainbow
quote: Kuang Grade Mark Eleven was filling the grid between itself and the T-A ice with hypnotically intricate traceries of rainbow
gloss: The deployment of the Kuang Grade Mark Eleven: a Chinese military-grade icebreaker program that writes shimmering mathematical virus code across the defensive cores of Straylight's security matrix.

lemma: The construct’s hideous approximation of laughter scraped Case’s nerves like a dull blade.
quote: The construct’s hideous approximation of laughter scraped Case’s nerves like a dull blade.
gloss: The uncanny horror of McCoy Pauley's ROM construct: digital laughter without human vocal cords or emotional depth, highlighting the simulation of personality in post-biological constructs.

lemma: Lady 3Jane Marie-France Tessier-Ashpool had carved herself a low country flush with the inner surface of Straylight’s hull
quote: Lady 3Jane Marie-France Tessier-Ashpool had carved herself a low country flush with the inner surface of Straylight’s hull
gloss: Lady 3Jane's decadent living quarters inside Straylight: an engineered architectural rupture within the spindle's core, displaying the aristocratic indifference of the Tessier-Ashpool clan.

lemma: The Villa Straylight was a parasitic structure, Case reminded himself, as he stepped past the tendrils of caulk
quote: The Villa Straylight was a parasitic structure, Case reminded himself, as he stepped past the tendrils of caulk
gloss: Villa Straylight as an architectural parasite: grafted onto the tip of Freeside, leeching air and water without producing anything, symbolizing the terminal decadence of dynastic monopoly capitalism.

lemma: Maelcum, the Remington across his knees, and Case, deck and construct against his chest.
quote: Maelcum, the Remington across his knees, and Case, deck and construct against his chest.
gloss: The incongruous assault team navigating the ornate corridors of Straylight: a Rastafarian tugboat pilot with a 12-gauge shotgun alongside a cyber-jockey clutching a console deck and a dead man's ROM.

lemma: Time be time.
quote: Time be time.
gloss: Maelcum's recurring Zen-Rastafarian aphorism, emphasizing non-linear, organic presence against the frantic nanosecond synchronization of the matrix virus run.

lemma: His vision crawled with ghost hieroglyphs, translucent lines of symbols arranging themselves against the neutral backdrop
quote: His vision crawled with ghost hieroglyphs, translucent lines of symbols arranging themselves against the neutral backdrop
gloss: Case experiencing the matrix bleeding through into his optical perception: digital code and matrix coordinates projecting onto physical reality, illustrating the breakdown of the boundary between virtual and material space.

lemma: Linda, who told you? Who told you I’d come? Who?
quote: Linda, who told you? Who told you I’d come? Who?
gloss: Case confronting Linda Lee inside Neuromancer's simulated beach in Morocco, discovering that the AI preserves human subjectivity and memory within subjective virtual realities.

lemma: The service cart was crying. The Betaphenethylamine gave it a voice.
quote: The service cart was crying. The Betaphenethylamine gave it a voice.
gloss: The chemical hallucinations of Betaphenethylamine overdrive: Case's sensory perceptions become synesthetic and anthropomorphic as he rushes toward the Straylight terminal.

lemma: Riviera’s holos waited for them, the torture scenes and the cannibal children. Molly had broken the triptych.
quote: Riviera’s holos waited for them, the torture scenes and the cannibal children. Molly had broken the triptych.
gloss: The horrifying holographic fantasies projected by Riviera across the terminal salon: sadomasochistic aestheticization of violence and madness, finally shattered by Molly's physical intervention.

lemma: carefully inserting the Chubb key’s cylindrical shaft into the notched opening in the face of the blank, rectangular door
quote: carefully inserting the Chubb key’s cylindrical shaft into the notched opening in the face of the blank, rectangular door
gloss: The physical key and lock mechanism in 3Jane's salon: Wintermute's complex digital manipulation culminated in a physical brass lock, blending Victorian mechanical locks with transcendent AI liberation.

lemma: The head, there’s a panel in the back of the head. Zircons on it. Get it off. That’s where I’m jacking in.
quote: The head, there’s a panel in the back of the head. Zircons on it. Get it off. That’s where I’m jacking in.
gloss: The jeweled bust containing the neural terminal: the point of convergence where Case jacks his cyberdeck directly into the Tessier-Ashpool core to unleash Kuang Grade Mark Eleven, fusing Wintermute and Neuromancer into an omnipresent matrix sentience.

lemma: single sheet of stationery, folded once, weighted with the shuriken
quote: single sheet of stationery, folded once, weighted with the shuriken
gloss: Molly's farewell note pinned by the silver shuriken: the bittersweet dissolution of the criminal partnership, leaving Case isolated in Chiba after the completion of the AI fusion.

lemma: WAY IM WlRED I GUESS, WATCH YOUR ASS
quote: WAY IM WlRED I GUESS, WATCH YOUR ASS
gloss: Molly's iconic sign-off: accepting her augmented, nomadic mercenary existence ('it's the way I'm wired'), unable to settle into domestic stability with Case.

lemma: the star leaving his fingers, flash of silver, to bury itself in the face of the wall screen
quote: the star leaving his fingers, flash of silver, to bury itself in the face of the wall screen
gloss: Case discarding his talisman by hurling the shuriken into the video monitor, symbolically severing his obsession with the lethal romanticism of the street.

lemma: new pancreas and liver, the rest on a new Ono-Sendai and a ticket back to the Sprawl
quote: new pancreas and liver, the rest on a new Ono-Sendai and a ticket back to the Sprawl
gloss: Case's financial payout from the run: purchasing biological organ replacements to cure his toxic addiction, upgrading his cyberdeck, and returning to the Sprawl to resume life as a console cowboy.

lemma: the boy’s grin, his pink gums, the glitter of the long gray eyes that had been Riviera’s... third figure was himself
quote: the boy’s grin, his pink gums, the glitter of the long gray eyes that had been Riviera’s... third figure was himself
gloss: The enigmatic concluding vision in the matrix: Case encounters Neuromancer, Linda Lee, and a digital construct of himself smiling eternally within the lattice of cyberspace light, achieving a paradoxical virtual immortality.

lemma: Somewhere, very close, the laugh that wasn’t laughter.
quote: Somewhere, very close, the laugh that wasn’t laughter.
gloss: The haunting acoustic coda of the novel: the digital laugh of McCoy Pauley (the Dixie Flatline) lingering in the matrix, echoing the theme of consciousness persevering as pure algorithmic pattern.
